fusions.name: Threads Between
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes a lash of silk that deals 10 damage and leaves it [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Silk Line
fusions.desc: Casts a line of silk that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 25% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Web Trap
fusions.desc: Spins a web onto the nearest enemy. It waits 60 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 20 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Strand Tugged
fusions.desc: When a condition you inflicted runs its course, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
